title: page-docs-wall — `/framework/core/Page/` Overview becomes a browsable wall: navigation band, recipes, JS last

set.request: core/Page Overview becomes a browse() wall in four bands (pages are navigation / the box / recipes / JS last); copy the 12 keeper demos, build mounts + replace + render, preserve the intro under old/intro.
steps: page.js: overview from BANDS, browse() wall
set.outcome:
**Follow-up fix landed** — `overview/render/page.js` was hand-marking its demo pages `.ac("active-page")`; inside the wall's `.page-preview-thumb` that matched `.active-ancestor:has(.page.active-page)` (Page.css:8) on the whole Doc view, which could steal width from a routed leaf. Both marks (the outer `column()` render and the nested "second `.page`" in the broken example) now use `.ac("default")` — the `ext/demo/app.js` convention for "shown without being routed to". Neither sits inside a `.pages` box, so the `.pages > .default` display-restore rule (Page.css:44) doesn't apply and wasn't needed.

Verified headless 3x: `document.querySelectorAll('.page-preview-thumb .page.active-page').length` is 0 site-wide on [/framework/core/Page/](/framework/core/Page/), and 0 specifically for mounts/replace/render's own cards. [/framework/core/Page/overview/render/](/framework/core/Page/overview/render/) still reads correctly — Correct vs Broken, doubled-padding tell intact.
